native_mechanisms: The die-stone never resets between marks: every fold carries the callus of all folds before it (one unbroken carried state, no re-seating).

Each mark's weight is pressed into the stone's already-turned position rather than onto a clean face, so earlier marks bend how later marks land — and each fold re-multiplies any difference, so differing paths never reconverge.
Only the stone's final seated position read against the wooden keeps leaves the desk; all intermediate turns and chalk residue are swept away and discarded.
core_technique: xxHash3-style 4-lane SIMD/scalar accumulator (lo32×hi32 widening products plus lane-swapped data adds) in which each input word is first XORed with a lagged, cross-lane-rotated copy of the accumulator ('callus') before multiplication, finished by mul128 xor-folding of the lanes plus length and a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer, with a separate serial multiply-fold path for len<64.
